narration.text: Every therapy authorisation renewed before visits run past it, each on its own payer's clock. This is a chore for the authorisation coordinator of an outpatient physical and occupational therapy group with eleven patients in ongoing care across five payers. Athena works it across 4 portals: Chartleaf EHR, Authgate, Authwise and Faxline. On the bench, she found 5 of 5 eligible items, worth 3,664 dollars of the 3,664 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. Among them: A Medicare Advantage renewal three weeks out, which the portal would return if sent today. A Medicaid managed care renewal that next Friday's run still has time for. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 62 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
